name: Save Video
description: Writes a video to the output folder, with the workflow embedded so the file can be dropped back onto Fugue. Plays on the node.

inputs.name: name
inputs.label: Name
inputs.description: {date} (yyyy-MM-dd), {time} (hh-mm-ss) and {model} (the model's file name without its extension) are filled in. A / makes a subfolder, for example {date}/{model}_{time}.

inputs.name: format
inputs.label: Format
inputs.description: mp4: H.264 and AAC, plays everywhere. webm: VP9 and Opus. A video already in the format is copied as it is.

inputs.name: embed
inputs.label: Embed workflow
inputs.description: full: the whole workflow. no-prompts: the workflow with its prompts blanked. none: nothing. Local file paths are never embedded.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.label: Folder
inputs.description: Where to write. Empty means the output folder (~/Pictures/Fugue).
